svg.aria-label: re-folding the log reconstructs the table
svg.text: Two views, one writer each — and the check that catches a gap
table a:24 b:21 · re-folded changelog agrees · a missed capture shows up
2 // Two of an event's five fields are CLOCKS, which ch01 established:
3 // et = event time, when it happened · pt = processing time, when we saw it
4 // v = the change this record applies · key = whose balance it changes
5 type Event { id, key, et, pt, v }
6 // primitive: EVENTS — the book's 9 events, in PROCESSING order (tools/stream_seed.js).
8 // primitive: NONE — no value. Distinct from a value of 0.
9 // primitive: KEYS — the keys the table has a row for. KEYS = ["a", "b"]
10 // primitive: max(a, b) — the larger of two values. max(3, 5) = 5
11 // primitive: append(xs, x) — xs with x added at the end. append([1], 2) = [1,2]
12 // primitive: indexOf(e) — e's position in PROCESSING order. indexOf(EVENTS[0]) = 0
18 // function: applyWrite(tbl, log, e, captureOn) — the application writes the TABLE;
19 // CDC writes the LOG. One writer each, which is the whole guarantee.
20 // applyWrite(tbl, log, EVENTS[0], true) appends Record("a", 0, 5)
25 if (captureOn) { log = append(log, Record(e.key, before, tbl.rows[e.key])) }
29 // function: foldLog(log) — re-derive the table from the changelog.
37 // function: totalOf(tbl) — add up every row.
47 // function: audit(tbl, log) — the continuous check: does the re-folded log match
48 // the real table? A mismatch means a WRITE THAT CDC MISSED.
50 // audit(tbl, a log missing one) = Audit(false, 45, 37)
56 // function: run(captureEvery) — replay the stream, capturing every write or not.
57 // run(true) leaves the audit agreeing; run(false) leaves it disagreeing.
64 log = applyWrite(tbl, log, e, captureEvery || last == false)
69 // function: main() — THE CALLER: a healthy run, and one with a missed capture.
Step 2/0 — re-folding the log reconstructs the table
`tbl.rows[r.key] = r.new` — each record names the result, so the fold is an assignment rather than an accumulation. The derived table ends at "a" = 24, "b" =
21, which is exactly the real one. That is the derivation this design's guarantee rests on.
